alternates.why: Same CG skeleton series, tighter rib-cage framing; cervical/upper thoracic vertebrae visible top-center 6.4-7.8s before jaw enters at ~7.9s. No hands, no face. Same tone drawbacks as 17088.

The only real physical spine model on Mixkit: natural-light clinic, spine reads instantly. But doctor's hands hold it and his face is visible (looking down at 11.5-12.7s, least frontal), patient seen from behind. Violates the no-hands spec and faces=avoid; use only if the spec is relaxed.

notes: Searched: 'spine model' (0 results), 'anatomy model' (1), 'skeleton model' (2), 'skeleton' (19), 'spine' (10), 'chiropractor' (16). Mixkit has no hands-free spine model still life. Closest candidates: 17088/47994 (CG skeleton torso, no hands/faces, but dark black background and rib cage dominant, spine only peripheral) and 36704 (real spine model but held by a doctor, faces visible). 47995 rejected: full skull dominates frame. All four downloads are 720p only (no 1080p on Mixkit for these). 17088 is copied to s12alt.mp4 as a placeholder so the timeline is not empty; since this shot is a backup for the director photo, recommend either using the director photo, shooting a 2-second spine-model insert at the clinic, or sourcing from Pexels/Pixabay ('spine model', 'vertebrae model').
